resources.string: Backup and merge
Current account ID
The current account has not been identified safely. Return to BeReal, refresh the feed and reopen this screen. Backup identity is never inferred from a post author.
Export your saved post links and details to a backup file, or merge a backup from another device using the same account. Existing posts are kept safely.
Export backup file
Import and merge backup
Associate unassigned old data

%1$d old or unassigned records have no viewer account identity. Their authors do not identify which account saved them. Associate them with account %2$s only after checking they belong to this account. Matching post IDs are merged; the original legacy table is retained locally.
Associate with this account

The file is not encrypted. It contains usernames, post dates, captions and full media URLs, including URL signatures. Do not share it publicly. Login passwords and authorization headers, media files, app settings and diagnostic logs are not included.
Choose destination
Transfers your saved post list and media links, not photo or video files themselves (expired links cannot be refreshed). Device transfers require exporting and importing manually.

No existing post is deleted. These counts are a preview; the merge rechecks the current database atomically. Conflicting author IDs abort the whole import.

The backup belongs to another account, or the active account changed. Nothing was merged.
The same post ID has conflicting author UIDs. The entire merge was cancelled; no existing records were changed.
Unsupported backup format or schema. Update the app or export a compatible backup.
The archive has invalid or future observation times. Check the source device clock before exporting again.
Backup exceeds supported limits: 64 MiB, 50,000 posts, 300,000 URLs or 1,024 URL alternatives per post.
This is not a valid, complete BeFuck SQLite backup. Nothing was merged.
The operation could not finish. Existing archive data is retained. Check storage and file access, then retry. An interrupted export may leave an incomplete destination file.
Unassigned old data. Open Backup and merge to associate it with the current account before combining devices.
